questions.question: The ________ dance is performed by shepherd community of Goa during Navratri.
questions.solution:

• **The Dhangar dance** is performed by the shepherd community of Goa during Navratri.

• It usually celebrated on the tenth day of Navarathri and Musical Instruments such as Dhol, Cymbal and a long flute named 'Pawa' are used.
 
• Songs are sung during this dance and they usually talk about the love story between Radha and Lord Krishna.

questions.question: DNA was first isolated, analysed and recognised as a unique macro-molecule by _______ in 1869.
questions.solution:
__
 
• Deoxyribonucleic Acid (DNA) was first isolated, analysed and reorganised as a unique macro-molecule by **Friedrich Miescher in 1869.****​**
 
• DNA is a molecule that exists in the form of a double helix and contains genetic information required by an organism to live, develop and reproduce.
 
• Deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) is a nucleic acid and is made up of nucleotide.
 
• Each nucleotide consists of a phosphate group, a nitrogenous base (A, T, G, C) and deoxyribose in a DNA.

questions.question: In June 2017, NASA successfully launched _________ mission to study the intersteller medium, the matter between stars.

questions.question: Which is the smallest bone in the human body?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Stapes**__ is the smallest bone in the human body
 
• Stapes is found in Ears and it is shaped like a stirrup.
 
• It is one of the three ear ossicles present in the human body with the three ossicles being Malleus, Incus and Stapes.
 
• The **Stapes** is a bone in the middle ear which is responsible for the conduction of sound vibrations in the inner ear.
 
• **Malleus **is a hammer-shaped small bone of the middle ear connecting with the Incus.
 
• **Incus** is a small bone in the middle ear which transmits vibrations between Malleus and Stapes.

questions.question: The construction work of the Rs. 500-crore Pagladiya Multipurpose Dam project in Nalbari district of _________ will begin from February 2019.
questions.solution:
• The Construction work of the Rs.500 crore Pagladiya Multipurpose Dam Project in Nalbari District of **Assam** has began from February 2019.
 
• This project has benefits to irrigate about 54,160 ha and incidental power generation of 3 MW.
 
• It was bulit across Pagladiya River at Thalkuchi in Baksa District which comes under Bodoland Territorial Autonomous Districts (BTAD) in Assam.
 
• This dam is also helpful in moderation floods in the Assam region.

questions.question: The first India-ASEAN Inno Tech Summit was held in ________ in November 2018.
questions.solution:
__
 
• The first India-ASEAN InnoTech Summit was held in **New Delhi** __in November 2018.
 
• The theme of this summit is**: Accelerating towards innovative development.**
 
• This summit was organised by the Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry (FICCI) in association with Ministry of External Affairs and Department of Science and Technology.
 
• This summit is a part of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations(ASEAN) India Innovation Platform Program.
 
• India-ASEAN InnoTech Summit is an annual event to strengthen the ties between India and ASEAN.

questions.question: In January 2019, Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Kollam Bypass. Which of the following is NOT true of the bypass?

options.text: It lies on the National Highway-66.
It is the first National Highway project in the country taken up on a 50 : 50 Centre-State partnership.
It is 18 km long and has three lanes.
Its opening would considerably reduce travel time between Alappuzha and Thiruvananthapuram.

questions.solution:
• **Kollam Bypass is a 2 lane, 13 Kilometer long road** which will help to reduce congestion in Kollam town.
 
• It was inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in January 2019.
 
• It was the first national highway where Center and State shared the cost of a project on 50:50 basis. 
 
• Construction of the bypass began in May 2015 and got completed in January 2019.

questions.question: Shot-putter ______ won a gold medal in the men's shot put event at the 2018 Jakarta-Palembang Asian Games held in Indonesia.
questions.solution:
• **Tejinder Pal Singh Toor** won a gold medal in the men's shot put event at the 2018 Jakarta-Palembang Asian Games held in Indonesia. 
 
• He won the India's first medal in athletics event in 2018 edition of Asian games.
 
• 18th edition of Asian Games was held in the Twin cities, Jakarta & Palembang in Indonesia. 
 
• India won a total of 15 gold, 24 Silver and 30 Bronze in 2018 Asian Games.
